publisher: I4C / National Cyber Crime Threat Analytics Unit
title: Advisory: Fake Stock Market Investment Websites/Apps

sections.section_title: Surge in Fake Stock Market and Trading Platform Cyber Threats
sections.content: The National Cyber Crime Threat Analytics Unit (TAU) of the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs, has observed an alarming rise in organized cybercrime syndicates defrauding Indian citizens through counterfeit stock market investment portals and fraudulent trading applications.
key_takeaways: Organized cybercrime syndicates targeting Indian investors
Counterfeit trading websites and investment platforms

sections.section_title: Social Media Solicitations and Deceptive Endorsements
sections.content: Perpetrators run deceptive sponsored campaigns across major social media channels including Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and WhatsApp. They claim affiliation with renowned domestic brokers, SEBI-registered portfolio managers, or foreign institutional desks, sharing fabricated profit screenshots to establish false credibility.
key_takeaways: Fabricated profit screenshots and falsified endorsements
Pretended affiliation with registered Indian brokerage houses

sections.section_title: Layering of Stolen Capital via Mule Accounts
sections.content: Victims are coerced into transferring investment capital into mule bank accounts registered in the names of third parties or unverified shell companies. These funds are swiftly layered through multiple intermediary bank accounts and often siphoned through crypto exchanges or peer-to-peer payment networks to obstruct asset recovery.
key_takeaways: Transfer of funds to personal mule accounts
Rapid layering to evade immediate bank freezing

sections.section_title: Citizen Safety Protocols and National Reporting Escalation
sections.content: Citizens are advised: (1) Never install APK files from untrusted links or chat messages. (2) Cross-verify broker authenticity on the SEBI portal prior to transferring funds. (3) Report cyber financial fraud immediately to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at www.cybercrime.gov.in or call Helpline 1930 within the golden hour to facilitate account lien placement.
key_takeaways: Never install untrusted APKs from messaging apps
Cross-verify broker details on SEBI portal
Immediate reporting to Helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
